_comment: Reference: how Path A (MCP Gateway) consumes the shared agent core. Not executable — documents the consumption pattern only.
name: MCP Gateway

system_prompt.how: Loaded at server startup via fs.readFileSync; embedded in each MCP tool handler's context. Step 1.2 (Phase 1) refactors mcp-server.ts to read from this file instead of inline strings.

tools.how: Tool name + description are read from each JSON file. Input schemas (Zod) and handler functions remain in lib/marco-polo/mcp-tools/*.ts. The JSON schemas are the source of truth — mcp-server.ts registerVisaTools() reads them at startup.

content.how: Read from disk at request time via skill-loader.ts and knowledge-loader.ts. No caching — every tool call reads the latest file. Content updates are live immediately without a server restart.

llm.who_pays: User (their Claude subscription via claude.ai MCP connector)
llm.model: User's choice (claude.ai defaults to Claude Sonnet)

cross_repo_note: The MCP server code lives in torlyAI repo; the agent-core content lives in Schengen-visa repo. Both repos are cloned on both machines. The mcp-server.ts reads from the cloned Schengen-visa path at runtime.
